findings.summary: Force-disabling paging for --list-themes reverts a feature maintainers added on purpose (PR #3239, fixed in #3457)
No CHANGELOG entry despite a behavior change, which CONTRIBUTING requires
PR body says the test verifies behavior, but cargo test was never run
The list-themes guard at app.rs:305-306 is now dead code

why: Finding 1 states the maintainer's reason in substance: paging for --list-themes was a deliberate recent feature and forcing it off reverses that choice.
